import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def clean_text(text):
    """Clean and process text content."""
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Handle unicode escapes and quotes
    # Remove outer quotes if present, unescape newlines
    cleaned = text.strip().strip('"')
    # Handle any remaining escape sequences
    cleaned = cleaned.replace("\\n", "\n")
    return cleaned


def main():
    # Load data
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

    # Sample for format reference (optional, to check column naming)
    if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH):
        sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

    # Prepare features and labels
    X_train_raw = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
    y_train = train_df["Insult"]

    # Add Date column to match structure (for consistency if needed, but ignored by model)
    # Ensure Test DF has same columns structure (Comment, Date)
    test_X_raw = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

    # Feature Extraction
    print("Vectorizing text...")
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
    )

    X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
    X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_X_raw)

    # Split Train into Train and Validation
    X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
    )

    # Train Model
    print("Training model...")
    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0, class_weight=None, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
    )
    model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

    # Evaluate on Validation Set
    print("Evaluating on Validation set...")
    y_val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, y_val_pred_proba)
    print(f"AUC-ROC on Validation Set: {val_auc:.4f}")

    # Generate Predictions on Test Set
    print("Generating predictions on Test set...")
    y_test_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

    # Create Submission DataFrame
    # Per instruction: "All predictions should be in the first column"
    # We will output only the prediction column to comply strictly with "first column" rule
    # Although sample_submission_null.csv has 3 cols, instructions take priority for submission format.
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Insult": y_test_pred_proba})

    submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")

    # Final check
    print("Script completed successfully.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
